feature: No-collection entry PR 2: the import's `I own these cards` tick and the ✕-only arrival dismiss (handoff design_handoff_the99_no_collection_entry, R2; plan 2026-10-15-no-collection-entry.md, PR 2)
note: Needs COLLECTION_EDIT_ENABLED=true and NO_COLLECTION_ENTRY_ENABLED=true for the reader. The S8 rows type a list and tick the box without pressing Import, so they write nothing. The S10 and S12 rows press Import, so each cell WRITES a deck (and, ticked, adds its three cards to the signed-in account's collection): run them on local-dev or a scratch branch only, never staging or production. They photograph the arrival strip with the ✕ alone, 44px on the phone and 32px on desktop. S11 (a refused add) cannot be forced from a browser and is proved by the component tests.
